setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_scalar_sales (region int4, price int4, adjustment int4)

INSERT INTO bench_scalar_sales SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%32 END, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%1001-500 END, CASE WHEN i%13=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%101-50 END FROM generate_series(1,250000) s(i)
accel_query_sql: SELECT region,sum(price) total,avg(price) mean,count(price) present,min(price) lo,max(price) hi,count(*) n FROM bench_scalar_sales WHERE price IS DISTINCT FROM adjustment GROUP BY region
